skills: Derive and implement backpropagation for any architecture.
Estimate the memory, compute, time and cost of a training run before starting it.
Train a Transformer from scratch and diagnose its instabilities.
Write fast GPU kernels and explain their speed with the roofline model.
Implement and choose between data, tensor, pipeline and expert parallelism.
Serve a model efficiently with KV caching, batching, quantisation and speculative decoding.
Implement post-training: fine-tuning, reward models, RLHF, DPO and RL from verifiable rewards.
Design evaluations and report results with honest error bars.
Read a new paper, reproduce its key result and explain it simply.
Use interpretability methods to test a hypothesis about a model.
